card.name: The word personal in web text
card.fires_on: The word "personal" (usually capitalized, sometimes lowercase) in general web text, as in personal communication, personal opinions, personal information, personal protective equipment or personal statement.

modes.label: Personal as sentence or list start
modes.description: Capitalized "Personal" opening a sentence or a list item, followed by a noun like communication, opinion or protective equipment.

modes.label: Personal inside a sentence
modes.description: Lowercase "personal" after a word such as to or keep, before a noun like life, information or reactions.

card.writes: It pushes some word endings like "ized" and "ities" and various Chinese tokens, while suppressing names like Emanuel; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "personal" when it begins a phrase such as personal information or personal protective equipment.
